slices.focus: Home repair costs from subfloor damage and yard regrading strain Caleb's savings and deepen his empathy for homeowners facing financial uncertainty
slices.summary: Hard rain causes subfloor damage at Caleb's house, requiring costly repair and yard regrading. The expense further thins their savings and forces another vacation delay. Caleb gains personal insight into how financial uncertainty freezes homeowners, making him want to add cost-range language to his outreach materials.
open_loops: Tighten spending to let savings recover
Add plain-language cost-range information to outreach materials
